title: structure-sweep index exports inventory internals: glob helpers, zod input schemas, lever constants
rawReport:
## Summary
PR #475 (`structure-sweep inventory`) exports glob helpers, the zod input schemas and the lever constants from `packages/structure-sweep/src/index.ts`, which is more public surface than #469 asked for. The package's export map is its contract, and it hasn't been published yet, so trimming is free now and breaking after the release.

## What I was doing
Reading the #469 lane hand-back before cutting the release PR.

## What I observed
The #475 reviewer logged a SEV4: besides the `inventory` entry point and its result types, `index.ts` re-exports the internal glob helpers, the zod schemas used to parse the input files, and the lever constants. Nothing outside `src/inventory/` uses them.

## Why it matters
Every export becomes a semver promise on the first publish. Exporting parser schemas and helpers ties future refactors of `inventory` to a minor/major bump.

## Pointers
- PR #475 and #469
- `packages/structure-sweep/src/index.ts`, `packages/structure-sweep/src/inventory/**`
- `scripts/verify-exports.mjs`

## Suggested next step (non-binding)
Export only `runInventory` (or the command's public entry) plus its result/entry types; keep the schemas, glob helpers and lever constants internal. Do it before the release PR is cut.

---

enriched:
## Summary

`packages/structure-sweep/src/index.ts` re-exports the internals of the `inventory` command that #469 / PR #475 added: the glob helpers, the zod input schemas and `readSource`, the lever table and its tuning constants, and `topLevelScope`. #469 asked the library to expose `buildInventory`, `renderInventory` and the entry types — its pending changeset `.changeset/structure-sweep-inventory.md` already says exactly that. `@demlik/structure-sweep` is still `0.0.0` and unpublished, so trimming the export is free today. After the first publish, every name in the index is a semver promise.

Scope is the **inventory block of the index only** (the `./inventory/*.js` re-exports). Other modules' exports in the index are out of scope.

## What is public after this change

Value exports (runtime): `buildInventory`, `renderInventory`.

Type-only exports (`export type { … }`): `Inventory`, `InventoryEntry`, `InventoryInputs`, `InventoryOptions`, `LeverStatus`, `Span`, and the two types their shapes reference, `Lever` and `Source`. A caller must be able to name every type in `buildInventory`'s signature and `Inventory`'s shape. The input record types `UnreachableInput`, `GraphInput`, `ConsolidateInput`, `PairInput` sit under `InventoryInputs` too, so they may be re-exported **type-only**. Their zod schema values may not.

Internal (dropped from the index, still exported from their own module for in-package use and tests):
- `src/inventory/glob.ts`: `anyGlob`, `globMatcher`
- `src/inventory/inputs.ts`: the zod schema values `ConsolidateInput`, `GraphInput`, `PairInput`, `PairsInput`, `UnreachableInput`; `readSource`
- `src/inventory/levers.ts`: `LEVERS`, `LEVER_ORDER`, `SAME_DECISION_FLOOR`, `SHARED_HELPER_FLOOR`, `SCOPE_DEPTH`, `DEFAULT_GENERIC_NAMES`, `type InputName`
- `src/inventory/build.ts`: `topLevelScope`

Triage note: at `origin/main` no file under `packages/structure-sweep/test/` imports from `src/index`. `test/inventory.test.ts` already imports `globMatcher`, `topLevelScope` and the input types from their module paths, so the test-import rewrite is probably empty. The script is `packages/structure-sweep/scripts/verify-exports.mjs`, not a root `scripts/` file. Its expected list names `buildInventory` and `renderInventory` and nothing else from inventory, so it should need no change.

Triage note: searched open issues and PRs for "structure-sweep" and the export-surface vocabulary. Nothing owns the index's public surface (#473 is README, #467/#474 are `pairs`), so this stays a standalone ticket.

## Boundary

Touch only: `packages/structure-sweep/src/index.ts`; import lines under `packages/structure-sweep/src/inventory/**` if they need it; `packages/structure-sweep/test/**`; `.changeset/`; `packages/structure-sweep/scripts/verify-exports.mjs` if it needs it. Do **not** touch `packages/structure-sweep/src/pairs/**` or `packages/structure-sweep/README.md`, because another lane owns those.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `packages/structure-sweep/src/index.ts` re-exports, from `./inventory/*.js`, exactly the values `buildInventory` and `renderInventory` plus the type-only names `Inventory`, `InventoryEntry`, `InventoryInputs`, `InventoryOptions`, `LeverStatus`, `Span`, `Lever`, `Source` (and optionally the type-only `UnreachableInput`, `GraphInput`, `ConsolidateInput`, `PairInput`), and nothing else from `./inventory/`.
- [ ] None of `anyGlob`, `globMatcher`, `readSource`, `LEVERS`, `LEVER_ORDER`, `SAME_DECISION_FLOOR`, `SHARED_HELPER_FLOOR`, `SCOPE_DEPTH`, `DEFAULT_GENERIC_NAMES`, `topLevelScope`, `PairsInput`, `InputName` appears in `packages/structure-sweep/src/index.ts`, and no zod schema from `src/inventory/inputs.ts` is re-exported as a value.
- [ ] A test under `packages/structure-sweep/test/` does `import * as api from "../src/index.js"` and asserts that `buildInventory` and `renderInventory` are functions and that none of the dropped runtime names above is a key of `api`. That way a future re-widening fails CI.
- [ ] No file under `packages/structure-sweep/test/` imports an inventory internal through `src/index`. Every such import goes to its module path (`../src/inventory/glob.js`, `../src/inventory/inputs.js`, `../src/inventory/levers.js`, `../src/inventory/build.js`).
- [ ] `packages/structure-sweep/scripts/verify-exports.mjs` still lists `buildInventory` and `renderInventory`, lists no dropped name, and passes after `pnpm --filter @demlik/structure-sweep build`.
- [ ] `.changeset/structure-sweep-inventory.md` (or a new `.changeset/*.md` note for `@demlik/structure-sweep`) names the library surface as exactly `buildInventory`, `renderInventory` and the type-only entry types listed above, and does not advertise any dropped name.
- [ ] The diff touches no file under `packages/structure-sweep/src/pairs/` and does not touch `packages/structure-sweep/README.md`.
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test` pass from the repo root.
